# A payment split stating an amount its currency cannot hold.
#
# 2.005 CAD is half a cent, and no CAD split can carry it. Writing it into the
# entry costs the file its balance twice over: the split is booked as some
# whole number of cents, and the residual is computed against the 2.005 the
# file stated, so the two disagree and GnuCash scrubs in an Imbalance split.
#
# What this fixture produces: the import is refused, naming the amount and the
# currency that cannot state it. It is refused rather than rounded, and that is
# not in tension with the rounding this tool does elsewhere — the two cases are
# different in kind. A computed figure has to reach the cent: 45.00 USD at
# 1.405 CAD/USD simply is 63.225, and GnuCash rounds it. A stated figure is the
# user's assertion of what happened, so 2.005 is either honoured or refused;
# quietly booking 2.01 would put a number in their books they never wrote.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_payment_split_must_be_consumed.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-SUBCENT"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-SUBCENT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 137.00
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-SUBCENT"
		Expenses:Bank Fees 2.005 CAD
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
